text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan is making an aggressive<n>bid for the
front! What's going to<n>happen as they take this
third<n>corner?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(So you're not even gonna give me a<n>second to
catch my breath, huh?<n>You've got first place in your
sights.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Honestly, this is even tougher<n>than when we
faced off at the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (...And I know why.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This whole time, Ryan has been<n>honing her skills in
the world of<n>racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
While I was goofing off, and at the<n>Arima Kinen and
the spring Tenno<n>Sho—all this time, she's been
racing<n>against herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(This is the strength of someone<n>who's lived with
the weight of<n>expectations on her shoulders!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...But you're not the only one.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Nothing... held... back!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Pant...
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Ha... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Faster... I want to be faster! I want to<n>be faster
than anyone alive!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wonder if those two were watching<n>as well...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Spectator in Suit
text_block_list.text: You ran very well, Ines. Incrediblywell!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Whoo! That was pretty great, kid!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming today,<n>everyone! I'll
be sure to keep doing<n>my best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Whoops. I was going to say that right<n>after the
race finished!)
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I hope that was enough. I hope my<n>running
inspired them to dream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You really do love running, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I want to make<n>everyone happy the
next time I run,<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race do you think I<n>should try next?
Got any<n>suggestions?!

Ines Fujin comes bounding into the<n>waiting room
still full of energy.<n>That's how I know we're on the
right<n>track with this plan.
choice_data_list: Well, what kind of race do you want?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What kind of race do I want?Uhh...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm more interested in<n>hearing what kind
of race everyone<n>else would be happy to see me
run<n>in...
choice_data_list: I'd like to see you run a race you enjoy!
I'd like to see you run a race you enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

Ines Fujin tilts her head in confusion.<n>Before we do
anything else, I decide<n>to have her rest for the day.
We can<n>discuss our goal another time.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
"In such cases, one of the<n>neighboring owners
may..." Ugh, I<n>can't! This is definitely not<n>lunch-break
reading.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! You're working this<n>afternoon? Yay!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! So, if you could choose,<n>what kind of race
would you want to<n>see me enter next?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I want to run in a race that<n>all the people
supporting me want to<n>see me in.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Like, any race would be fine byme! Wait, so this means you'regonna, like, run in another race, right?You better tell us which one thesecond you choose!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Really? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho, the Queen<n>Elizabeth II Cup,
the Mile<n>Championship, the Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Why are there are so many fall G1s?!<n>Would it be
inspiring if I tried my hand<n>at a new distance? Or
maybe a more<n>prestigious race would...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha. You're really stewing on this<n>one, huh, Ines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan! How'd your doctor's<n>appointment go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There's some inflammation in my<n>legs, so I'm
supposed to take it easy.<n>But I'll be running again
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But anyway, what's your next race<n>gonna be?
C'mon, you gotta tell me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is... I have no idea.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in a race that would<n>make everyone
happy, but I have no<n>idea which one would be best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm... What if you flipped that around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Instead of trying to figure out whichrace would make people happy, howabout figuring out how you want tomake them happy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Or something like that. Sorry, I'm not<n>trying to talk
down to you or anything.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I think you're on to<n>something! You
always know what to<n>say, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want to run in the autumn<n>Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone traveled really far to<n>support me at the
Takarazuka Kinen<n>and the Asahi Hai F.S., right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I figured if I ran in some Tokyo<n>races, it'd be
way easier for them to<n>come cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the fall Tenno's all about speed,<n>right? I can't
wait to try running in a<n>race like that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But do you think that reason's a<n>little flimsy?
Should I be thinking on<n>more of a grand scale?
choice_data_list:
Nope, that's perfect! Let's take on the autumn
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ohoho! Yay! ♪ I'm glad you're<n>excited too!

More important than the name or<n>prestige of a race
is whether or not<n>she actually wants to run in it.

So if she wants to go for the Tenno<n>Sho, I'm sure
she'll run true to<n>herself.
